binding_rules: visualization rows must derive from canonical_rows
rejected rows must not be projected as canonical visualization rows
visualization counts must reconcile with canonical row count or declare aggregation policy
row_id-only visualization binding is transitional and must reference row_content_digest
orphan visualization rows are blockers unless explicitly marked not produced
known_open_gaps: existing v6_x2 HTML still carries embedded row data
v6_x6 documents the binding contract but does not rewrite the HTML renderer
orphan and multi-bind visualization fixture checks remain v6_x7 work
safe_wording: Visualization externalization means local report shaping only. It is not dashboard authority, governance certification, external publication, or GMUT validation.
